mapper.insert: INSERT INTO receipts (payment_id, store_id, order_id, place_id, receipt_date, approve_number, join_number) VALUES (#{paymentId}, #{storeId}, #{orderId}, #{placeId}, #{receiptDate}, #{approveNumber}, #{joinNumber})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT S.store_name, U.name AS owner, S.phone_number, S.store_place, O.order_id, R.receipt_date, PLACE.place_name, R.approve_number, R.join_number, O.price AS totalAmount, R.created_at FROM receipts R INNER JOIN stores S ON R.store_id = S.store_id INNER JOIN orders O ON R.order_id = O.order_id INNER JOIN users U ON S.user_id = U.user_id INNER JOIN payments P ON O.order_id = P.order_id INNER JOIN places PLACE ON R.place_id = PLACE.place_id WHERE R.payment_id = #{paymentId}

SELECT DISTINCT P.paid_money, P.payment_type, CASE WHEN P.payment_type = 'CASH' THEN NULL ELSE C.card_company END AS card_company, CASE WHEN P.payment_type = 'CASH' THEN NULL ELSE C.card_number END AS card_number, CASE WHEN P.payment_type = 'CASH' THEN NULL ELSE C.expiry_date END AS expiry_date FROM payment_detail P LEFT JOIN cards C ON P.payment_id = C.payment_id WHERE P.payment_id = #{paymentId}
